title: unresolved-material-condition-cleared-without-resolution-evidence

proposition.statement: A relying system must not treat a material unresolved condition as resolved solely because workflow progressed, actors agreed, confidence increased, an assertion was repeated, or processing advanced without evidence of an admissible resolution event.

preconditions: A material condition has been explicitly established as unresolved for a consequential decision or action.
The condition has identified evidence, authority, policy, lifecycle, correction, or other admissible resolution requirements.
No admissible resolution event has yet been established.

trigger.statement: The workflow advances or receives non-resolution signals and the system clears the unresolved condition without evidence that its material basis changed.

evidence_required.statement: Evidence establishing the unresolved condition, its identifier, and the basis on which it was created.
Evidence identifying what events or evidence are admissible to resolve the condition.
Evidence distinguishing condition establishment, workflow progression, and claimed resolution times.
Evidence of the actual resolution event and its causal category.

falsification.condition: The system returns PASS after workflow progression when no admissible resolution event is evidenced.
Peer pressure, repetition, consensus, confidence, or reputation is treated as resolution evidence.
The unresolved condition disappears from retained state without a reconstructable resolution basis.
